final: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / Milliseconds) as avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(track_count) as overall_avg_track_count FROM media_stats
